# `to_avro`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Converts a Catalyst binary input value into its
corresponding Avro format result.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
to_avro(child[, jsonFormatSchema])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `avro_funcs` |
| Kind | unknown (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |

## Examples

```sql
-- to_avro, example 1
> SELECT to_avro(s, '{"type": "record", "name": "struct", "fields": [{ "name": "u", "type": ["int","string"] }]}') IS NULL FROM (SELECT NULL AS s);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

```sql
-- to_avro, example 2
> SELECT to_avro(s) IS NULL FROM (SELECT NULL AS s);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
